title: Arum Spinosa
extract:
Arum Spinosa is an  Infested Warfan that shoots  Toxin projectiles on Heavy Attack.

Characteristics
This weapon primarily deals  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Slicing Feathers and  Votive Onslaught stance.
Heavy Attacks throw toxic spines, with each spine doing 70 base damage.
The first heavy attack throws 18 spines, each with a 2.5x damage multiplier; the second heavy attack in sequence throws 9 spines, each with a 5x damage multiplier,
Damage of the spines are affected by mods.
Spines are considered a heavy attack. Their damage will scale from the combo counter and mods such as  Killing Blow.
Spines have innate Punch Through.
Spine damage does not diminish with distance.
Has a travel time.
Has a limited range of ~35 meters.
Cannot use Thrown Melee mods  Combo Fury,  Power Throw,  Quick Return ( Volatile),  Rebound ( Volatile), and  Whirlwind.

Acquisition
The Arum Spinosa's blueprint and components can be acquired from Tier 2 (Lvl 40-50) Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana). The blueprint and components can also be purchased from Loid after reaching Rank 2 - Clearance: Modus with  Necraloid, requiring  8,000 for the blueprint and  6,000 for each of the components. The blueprint and all components can be traded.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

Combos

Notes
Warfan slams hit twice.
Second hit of a heavy slam will use the stats of a normal slam.

Trivia
The name of the weapon may have come from the English word "Arum", and Italian word "Spinoso".
The arum is a flowering plant seen in Europe, northern Africa, and western and central Asia.
"Spinoso", in Italian, means "Prickly", or "Thorny".
